scope.intent: replace the Node player-helper with the Rust zos-vod-player service and complete the reliability and naming migration

appliedFixes: Moved controller shutdown to a dedicated high-priority signal and deduplicated recovery scheduling across mpv failure events.
Classified transient startup failures as recoverable while keeping deterministic media failures terminal.
Stabilized permission error mapping and made corrupt-session quarantine best effort.
Added ZOS_NAS_ROOTS parity and persistent socket/state path validation compatible with PrivateTmp.
Hardened refresh-script TOML parsing and added broker-client and fake-mpv timeout coverage.
Documented persistent path constraints and the legacy service upgrade sequence.

testingGaps: A real Debian package and systemd service were not built or installed on the macOS review host.
DRM/ALSA hotplug, hardware decoding, physical NAS detach/reattach, power-loss, and forced failure acceptance require a target appliance.
residualRisks: The external mpv, DRM, ALSA, and systemd integrations are source-tested and Linux-target checked but still require target-device acceptance.
Rollback requires restoring the pre-vod-player configuration backup; the legacy in-memory playback session is not migrated.

verification.browserResponsiveChecks: passed for the main app and VOD busy/recovering/error states at desktop and 820/560/390/320 px breakpoints
verification.debianPackage: not built locally; Linux release gate
